task: Make code block headers sticky so Copy/Download buttons remain accessible when scrolling through long code blocks (Approach C / Codex Desktop style).

key_reasoning.reason: Touches CodeBlock.tsx (sticky class or new stickyHeader prop), optionally MarkdownTokens.tsx (1-line prop pass), and CodeBlock.scss (container-type interaction check). All within the same CodeBlock component directory — no cross-cutting concerns, no stores, no API.

Approach C (CSS sticky header) is decided and unambiguous. Two minor open decisions remain — whether sticky is unconditional vs. opt-in via prop, and whether to handle the rounded-t-lg visual artifact when stuck — but neither blocks implementation start.

The sticky top-0 z-10 pattern is established in at least 6 codebase locations (Table thead, ConfigPanel, FormSection, etc.). The one nuance is container-type: inline-size on .code-block-header potentially conflicting with position: sticky in some browsers; mitigation (outer wrapper div) is documented in the technical analysis.

3–4 files total: CodeBlock.tsx (1–3 line change), CodeBlock.scss (possible wrapper adjustment), MarkdownTokens.tsx (optional 1-line prop pass), CodeBlock.integration.test.tsx (new class-presence assertions). All within 2 directories.
